cohort: SARS-CoV-2 infected pregnant women presenting to Sri Aurobindo Institute of Medical Sciences, India, between April 1, 2020 and May 30, 2021.
finding: The second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a higher maternal mortality rate compared to the first wave.
mod_finding: Higher mortality was observed with cesarean section, suggesting it may not be the preferred mode of delivery in COVID-19 patients with respiratory distress.
